value.rationale: The fan is a canonical maximal outerplanar triangulation. The theorem supplies complete integral homotopy data for every size, a linear multiplicity law and a three-periodic sphere dimension from rapidly proliferating matching faces. The first-apex cone kills an otherwise surviving sphere in one congruence class, a structural phenomenon absent from the general qualitative theorem. It is a natural infinite-family classification and not an arbitrary finite numerical slice.
